# (PART) Value-Based Decisions {-}

# Value As Drift {#value-as-drift}

*This chapter has not been written yet.*

In a value-based decision, such as choosing between two snacks or two gambles, nothing
on the screen moves. The DDM still applies: the drift is the difference in value between
the two options, multiplied by a weight that says how strongly value drives choice. The
chapter builds a drift that changes from trial to trial with the options on offer, shows
that `ddm_density()` already accepts one drift per trial, and connects the model to the
logistic and softmax choice models used for choices alone (Chapter \@ref(predictions)).
